name: Chapel
narrativeOnEnter: Chapel. Worn pews, stone altar. A bell mechanism in the corner. A sealed door behind the altar.

hotspots.label: Maintenance Passage
hotspots.lockedMessage: A heavy bolt seals this door. The bell mechanism nearby might control it.

action.text:
A sheet of paper, folded carefully.

'The maintenance passage bolt is released by the bell mechanism.
The sequence was chosen so it cannot be triggered accidentally.

To operate:
  Approach the bell mechanism.
  Watch the sequence of symbols it shows.
  Repeat the same sequence in the same order.

Five correct strikes disengages the bolt.
If you make a mistake, the mechanism will show the sequence again.'

Stone altar. Plaque: 'For those who could not leave.'
Scratched below: '1972. We tried.'

Stained glass above — a figure before an open door. Entering or leaving, unclear.
